XML/HTML5 DOM handoff now rejects unsafe XML DTD/entity inputs, treats MathML token text integration descendants as HTML-cased review content while nested SVG re-enters foreign-content casing, recovers bounded HTML fragments with HTML5 void-element serialization, and hands serialized review fragments to WordPress HTML blocks without invoking Pandoc, browser renderers, online sanitizers, or external conversion services. CSL bibliography handoff preserves source-access dates and author/editor name particles/suffixes for reviewer audit lists without invoking citeproc or bibliography managers. BibTeX/BibLaTeX handoff now lets WordPress import review packets resolve common `.bib` entries into the same CSL citation and bibliography output while preserving missing keys for follow-up without invoking Pandoc, BibTeX, or Biber. Legacy DOC/CFB handoff now honors Word FIB fExtChar Unicode text ranges and rejects encrypted .doc streams before exposing text, so WordPress review queues get readable Unicode legacy packets while encrypted sources stay explicit follow-up items. Table geometry now preserves body-level rowHeadColumns as WordPress th cells by visual column, scopes rowspans to table sections, and reports declared-column overflow diagnostics, so reviewer queue row headers survive rowspans while malformed imported tables keep overflow cells visible for audit instead of silently dropping content. ZIP package preflight surfaces central/local extended and NTFS media timestamps, rejects conflicting metadata, and rejects Unix symlink entries before WordPress treats embedded Office media as importable attachment bytes. Archive preflight reads gzip-wrapped tar review packets and LZ4-framed tar review packets with safe regular file/directory entries, skippable reviewer metadata, and validated frame checksums before exposing import bytes. DOCX body handoff imports ZIP/OPC Word packages into AST and WordPress blocks, exposes a native import report for relationships, media bytes, tracked-change revisions, comment-range reviewer metadata, bookmark anchors for internal Word links, field-code hyperlinks for Word-created source links, and section page-geometry/margin/column/header-footer metadata for layout review, preserves bounded OMML inline/display formulas as native math spans, and keeps suppressed deleted Word text plus dummy `_GoBack` return bookmarks out of rendered output. Math/TeX handoff emits MathML semantics annotations carrying escaped source TeX for reviewer and accessibility tooling without invoking MathJax, KaTeX, or TeX engines. PDF review-packet handoff now records expected TeX sidecars, fake-produced artifact hashes, log warnings/errors, and rerun-needed signals so WordPress import queues can triage failed or incomplete PDF exports without running renderers. ODT, CSL/BibTeX, YAML, doctemplate, archive compression, math/TeX, legacy DOC/CFB, charset, XML/HTML5 DOM, and PDF engine handoff paths remain native PHP and external-tool free. EPUB3 package handoff preserves OCF container and OPF metadata, spine order, nav/NCX table-of-contents targets, missing non-spine asset diagnostics, and raw XHTML spine content as WordPress HTML blocks without invoking Pandoc, zip/unzip, or browser renderers. Math/TeX handoff now also preserves TeX prime notation such as derivative marks in editable source spans and native MathML review packets without external math renderers. DOCX body handoff now also preserves tracked paragraph/run formatting revisions as reviewer metadata spans and import-report formatting counts, keeping previous-format provenance visible for WordPress review without rendering hidden text or invoking office tools. Legacy DOC handoff smoke now includes FIB fHasPic inline picture placeholders rendered as safe metadata-only review spans without exposing image bytes.
